mapper.select: SELECT id, title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM community_activity WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover_url, a.content, a.registration_start, a.registration_end, a.activity_start, a.activity_end, a.max_participants, a.current_participants, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.deleted, r.id AS reg_id, r.check_in_status AS reg_check_in_status FROM community_activity a LEFT JOIN activity_registration r ON r.activity_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE a.status != 'DRAFT' AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.activity_start DESC

SELECT id, title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM community_activity WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT id, title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM community_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') ORDER BY id

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover_url, a.content, a.registration_start, a.registration_end, a.activity_start, a.activity_end, a.max_participants, a.current_participants, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.deleted, r.id AS reg_id, r.check_in_status AS reg_check_in_status FROM activity_registration r INNER JOIN community_activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.activity_start DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_activity (title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{coverUrl}, #{content}, #{registrationStart}, #{registrationEnd}, #{activityStart}, #{activityEnd}, #{maxParticipants}, #{currentParticipants}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE community_activity SET title = #{title}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, content = #{content}, registration_start = #{registrationStart}, registration_end = #{registrationEnd}, activity_start = #{activityStart}, activity_end = #{activityEnd}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE community_activity SET current_participants = current_participants + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND current_participants < max_participants
UPDATE community_activity SET current_participants = current_participants - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND current_participants > 0
UPDATE community_activity SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
